target: Replace audit-heavy repository workflow with risk-laned evidence economy, deterministic pre-push contract validation, and one-final-audit execution
invariants: Runtime truth, authority boundaries, fail-closed proof, and explicit operator merge/destructive gates remain unchanged.
The change reduces model and token usage without weakening L2/L3 independent-audit or PR Steward requirements.
L0 deterministic changes do not require model audit unless they alter meaning, authority, security, workflow, or public behavior.
L2/L3 changes receive exactly one independent audit after the content head is frozen.
Proof-only successors validate schema, signature, ancestry, and changed paths deterministically and do not trigger a second content audit.
CI-equivalent changed-file checks run before first push.
Hooks that modify files must be rerun and pass cleanly before push.
Bounded metadata failures are repaired within the active packet rather than spawning recursive Task Packets.
Ordinary main or PR drift triggers affected-scope reharvest, not blanket stop.
No production, service, credential, permission, merge, close, mark-ready, branch-delete, force-push, or history-rewrite action is authorized.

execution.stacked_because: Fresh isolated governance/tooling worktree; not stacked.

verify: No runtime service, product behavior, schema, workflow YAML, credential, signer, or production path changes.
Governance documents agree on risk lanes, one-final-audit policy, proof-only successor handling, and pre-push gates.
The validator is deterministic, offline, and model-free.
No existing Task Packet or proof bundle is rewritten except this packet's own proof.

pr.title: feat(governance): evidence-economy execution and pre-push contract gate
pr.body: Replace ritualized multi-model stages with risk lanes, one final independent audit for material changes, deterministic proof/packet validation before push, resilient drift handling, and compact proof/handoff requirements. No runtime or production mutation.

steps.task: Preflight repository truth, current governance, and open-PR overlap.
requirements: Capture repo root, current main, worktree, branch, status, and targeted-file blob hashes.
Harvest open PRs touching the allowlist.
Classify overlaps as IDENTICAL, SUBSET, SUPERSET, COMPATIBLE, CONFLICTING, or UNKNOWN.
Do not blanket-stop for ordinary main drift or non-conflicting overlap.
commands: gh pr list --repo DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp --state open --limit 200 --json number,title,headRefOid,baseRefName,files
validation: Dedicated worktree and branch identity are proven.
Target-file overlap is classified with exact PR/head/path evidence.
CONFLICTING authority or security overlap stops affected-file editing and escalates.

steps.task: Write the canonical evidence-economy policy and reconcile governing docs.
requirements: Add L0-L3 risk lanes.
Replace mandatory model-stage chains with risk-appropriate deterministic checks and one final audit.
Define no-audit handling for deterministic metadata and proof-only successors.
Define one repair attempt per substantive model failure.
Define rolling cluster adjudication and affected-scope reharvest.
Preserve truth hierarchy, system boundaries, operator authority, and fail-closed semantics.
validation: No document still mandates a model audit for L0 deterministic changes.
No document still mandates repeated audits of unchanged content.
L2/L3 final independent audit and PR Steward remain required.
Routing policy uses live selectors and records UNKNOWN when unverified.

requirements: Create scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py.
The command accepts base/head refs and optional allowlist.
Classify changed paths into L0/L1/L2/L3 using a checked-in deterministic mapping.
Validate Task Packet JSON against the canonical schema.
Validate changed Task Packet Markdown frontmatter without silently fixing it.
Validate changed implementation and canonical embedded-audit proofs.
Detect hooks that would modify changed files by running them in check mode or inspecting a clean rerun result.
Validate proof-only successor path closure when parent/audited/head SHAs are supplied.
Emit stable JSON and concise text summaries.
Never call a model, network service, or mutate files.
validation: Tests cover clean L0 metadata, L2 governance, L3 security, invalid packet, missing frontmatter, invalid proof, modified-by-hook, proof-only valid, and proof-only escaped-path cases.
Output ordering and exit codes are deterministic.
The script performs no network or model invocation.

steps.task: Wire the deterministic preflight into local changed-file validation.
requirements: Add one pre-commit hook for the validator.
Avoid duplicate hook IDs.
The hook must not auto-fix files.
The hook must run before expensive broad checks where ordering supports it.
Existing docs-frontmatter and proof-schema hooks remain authoritative.
validation: The new hook passes on the packet branch.
A fixture branch with missing frontmatter fails before push.
A fixture implementation proof missing embedded_audit fails before push.
A proof-only escaped-path fixture fails closed.

steps.task: Validate behavior, governance consistency, and token-economy acceptance.
requirements: Run focused tests and all governance/audit/PR Steward tests affected by the change.
Measure the documented model-call budget for L0-L3 example workflows.
Prove L0 uses zero model calls, L1 at most one implementer model, and L2/L3 one implementer plus one final independent auditor by default.
Prove audit failure does not recursively create a new Task Packet for deterministic metadata repair.
validation: All relevant tests pass.
Policy examples satisfy the model-call budgets.
No runtime or workflow behavior changed.

steps.task: Run one final independent audit on the frozen content head.
requirements: This is an L2 governance/process change, so one independent final audit is required.
Preferred implementer is Codex with exact live selector recorded.
Preferred auditor is AGY with a live-listed independent Gemini model; fallback Claude Code Sonnet.
The auditor reviews the complete frozen content diff, validator threat model, tests, governance consistency, and any overlap decisions.
No intermediate model audit is permitted.
validation: Auditor is independent of implementer.
Audit is bound to the frozen content head.
Verdict is PASS or non-blocking PASS_WITH_RISKS.
FAIL, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, SKIPPED, stale proof, unknown identity, or head mismatch blocks finalization.

steps.task: Create proof-only successor, push, open PR, and run PR Steward.
requirements: Create implementation proof and canonical signed embedded audit.
The successor changes only this packet's proof and canonical PR audit directory.
Run changed-contract preflight again on the final head.
Push normally, open a PR, harvest CI, and run PR Steward.
Do not merge.
commands: gh pr create --base main --head "$BRANCH" --title 'feat(governance): evidence-economy execution and pre-push contract gate' --body-file "$PR_BODY"
validation: Final head passes deterministic preflight.
Proof-only successor path closure is proven.
CI and PR Steward are current on the final head.
No merge or destructive action occurred.
